[P2] Verify SDK identity before unwrapping an error

Matching an ordinary `errorType` property also accepts application errors. For example, a child handler throwing an error named `PaymentError` with `errorType: "StepError"` and a `TypeError` cause now checkpoints the inner `TypeError` and its message, discarding the application failure that the base preserved. Restrict this predicate to genuine SDK wrappers, using an SDK brand if cross-module identity is required. Add coverage for a user error whose `errorType` matches a wrapper name; the existing `LambdaStyleError` test does not exercise this collision.
